headline: The entire catalog, free. Engineering answers when you need them.
intro: SpaceAware puts satellites, Earth, weather and the solar system in one workspace in your browser. Public data stays free and visible without signing in. Plans add the analysis modules, and AI that runs them for you.
dataRule: Public records stay free and visible without signing in, each with its credit and terms. Plans pay for processing, never for the records themselves, and paying does not change any source's terms. Every source carries one rights class.

general.title: General-purpose rights
general.text: Free for any use, commercial included, with the credit each source asks. Share-alike sources require derived records to carry the same terms.

non-commercial.title: Non-commercial rights only
non-commercial.text: Free for non-commercial use only. Shown signed out and free; no plan sells them.

results.title: Results only
results.text: Used to compute results and cited by name. The records themselves are never republished.

talkingPoints.title: Start with what the customer wants to do
talkingPoints.text: Explore data: Free. Weather in high definition: Plus. Run engineering studies: Analysis. Have AI run them: AI. Space combat or UDL: SpaceEdge.

talkingPoints.title: Keep the data free
talkingPoints.text: Free and non-commercial data capabilities stay in Free. Paid plans add processing, software tools and workflows; they do not sell access to those datasets or expand their usage rights.

talkingPoints.title: Use the right product name
talkingPoints.text: SpaceAware is the workspace. Space Data Network carries data and software. SDN-AP is the propagator. OrbPro is the visualization engine. SpaceEdge is the government offering.

talkingPoints.title: Keep government separate
talkingPoints.text: The public plans page shows SpaceEdge in its own band below the four plans. Lead with SpaceEdge only with government buyers.
